additional_info.subject: RE: ID0422066-DC/Si-D/DE-[Y2 / S7 313808292010] Defective charging point CRM:02698000096
additional_info.body:
Hello ﻿Eduard Huber,
The charger is currently running on an old firmware version (3.2.8). We recommend updating it to the latest firmware, as the newer version includes important bug fixes and enhancements that can help analyze and address the cable temperature error more effectively.
At present, the charger is showing a cable temperature error. I will reboot the unit to see if this resolves the issue. We will inform you of the outcome after the reboot.
If the issue persists, we recommend keeping the outlet inoperative for safety reasons.
To address the issues you've encountered, upgrading the charger’s firmware is strongly advised. These updates typically include bug fixes, performance improvements, and better compatibility with EV communication protocols—helping to mitigate the errors you’ve been experiencing.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.

additional_info.subject: Error flag on SCB
additional_info.body:
DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100        PLC        DEVICE        true        VIV:0 CCE:0 RNE:1 PLE:0 SOV:0 COV:0 CBL:0 KON:1 CAB:0 HOU:0
The following values show the error state (OK state would be the negated value):
VIV:0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
RNE:1 → in case of an sensor reading outside the defined operation range
KON:1: → in case the contact temperature sensors are not okay
